description: Save a trip (hotel, sights, food spots — any places), plus the chosen flights and hotel, to GeoTok and get a public trip page. The page shows the flights and stay and every place on a map; opening it on an iPhone with the GeoTok app puts each place on the user's map, keeps the trip (flights, stay and day-by-day map) available offline, and the app reminds them when they are near one. Each item needs a name; lat/lng, address, kind, note and day are optional, and places without coordinates are looked up by name. Items must not contain personal details.

bookings.description: Flights and hotels the user chose or booked in this chat; they are shown with the trip under 'Flights & stay' and kept offline in the GeoTok app. Itinerary facts only — never confirmation codes, ticket numbers or traveller names (the trip page is public; the user adds those privately in the app).

name: save_trip_to_geotok
title: Save trip to GeoTok
